# secobserve_license (Data Source)

Looks up a single SPDX license reference by its exact spdx_id, for example `MIT` or `Apache-2.0`.

Licenses are system-managed: SecObserve seeds them from the SPDX license list and there is no write endpoint. Use this data source to resolve an spdx_id to the numeric id required by `secobserve_license_group` and `secobserve_license_policy_item`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve an SPDX license id to the numeric id secobserve_license_group and
# secobserve_license_policy_item expect.
data "secobserve_license" "mit" {
  spdx_id = "MIT"
}

output "mit_license_id" {
  value = data.secobserve_license.mit.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `spdx_id` (String) Exact SPDX license identifier, for example `MIT` or `Apache-2.0`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the license.
- `is_deprecated` (Boolean) Whether the SPDX identifier is deprecated. Null if unknown.
- `is_osi_approved` (Boolean) Whether the license is OSI-approved. Null if unknown.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `reference` (String) Reference URL or text for the license.
